## Preferred correction route

For ordinary project-record corrections, please use https://index80.com/submit/ or email hello@index80.com. Use this issue template when a public GitHub trail is useful for a repository-related correction.

## Notes

A correction request does not automatically change editorial status. INDEX:80 maintainers review evidence before governed project data is changed.
